name: UNIPAC
recent: UNIPAC 于 2026 年 9 月在 ACE Market 上市，近期获得 PETRONAS Carigali 在沙巴和砂拉越的合约，并涉及重大诉讼公告。最新季度（截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日）业绩已发布。
notable: 获得 PETRONAS Carigali 在沙巴和砂拉越地区的合约。
通过 IPO 在 ACE Market 上市，发行 1.3922 亿股新股，每股 RM0.35。
发布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度的季度报告。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，相关公告于 2026 年 9 月 3 日、9 月 10 日及 11 月 5 日发布。
董事及高管在 IPO 后于公开市场进行股份交易。

recent_en: UNIPAC listed on the ACE Market in September 2026, recently secured contracts from PETRONAS Carigali for Sabah and Sarawak, and has material litigation announcements. Latest quarterly results (ended 31 Aug 2026) have been released.
notable_en: Secured contracts from PETRONAS Carigali for Sabah and Sarawak regions.
Listed on the ACE Market via IPO, issuing 139.22 million new shares at RM0.35 per share.
Released quarterly report for the period ended 31 Aug 2026.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, with announcements on 3 Sep, 10 Sep, and 5 Nov 2026.
Directors and senior management traded shares in the open market after the IPO.
